title: Receptions
description: Every signal a recipe heard for one record, at <record>.reception.json beside it (competitors/acme/signals.reception.json beside competitors/acme/signals.json), as of one render (autoresearch design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/AUTORESEARCH_RECORDS_2026-11-06.md, "Noise stored beside the record"). Only the projector writes it. Each heard signal is salient or noise for this record (a noise reception the venture probed is marked with its rate), with its bitemporal stamps and the factors the engine computed, and later a hindsight label. Noise has a checked meaning: the recipe makes a byte-identical record without the signal. A signal heard by two recipes has a reception in each one's file, so it can be salient for one record and noise for another. The signal pull writes it beside each record a live recipe renders (build plan item 9).

record.description: The record these receptions are for, as a logical path in the venture

recipe.description: sha256 of the recipe source that rendered the record

as_of.description: The transaction time of the render: every signal observed at or before it was heard

receptions.description: One per heard signal, in (time, id) order, none twice

kind.description: salient: the record depends on the signal. noise: the recipe makes a byte-identical record without it

fields.description: On a salient reception, the record fields the signal fed

predicate.description: The test that failed, when the recipe names one (a listener predicate's id, a knob)

failed.description: On a noise reception, every reason the recipe gave

rate.description: The probe rate it was drawn at (research.probe_rate in naive.config.json), which is the chance it was surfaced

probe.description: On a noise reception only: the signal was surfaced to a person anyway, drawn deterministically from the record's path and the signal's id below the probe rate, so its outcome can score a recipe that would surface it, weighted by one over the rate (packages/naive/src/engine/recipes/probes.ts)

withdrawn_at.description: When a later signal retracting or superseding it was observed, as known at the render; null while it stands

factors.description: Bitemporal factors the engine computes as of the render. Recipes read them and cannot define them

lag.description: Seconds from valid time to transaction time

age.description: Seconds from the signal's transaction time to the render

producer_confirmed.description: The share of the producer's earlier signals a second producer or a person confirmed, or null with none settled yet

producer_withdrawn.description: The share of the producer's earlier signals later retracted or superseded, or null with none settled yet

uptake.description: How often a person acted on what this record surfaced, from decisions and the traces of the runs behind them, or null with no history (computing it is not built, so it is null)

hindsight.description: Set by a signal pull once the render's as-of point plus the record type's horizon has passed: the loss without the signal against the loss with it, each against the settled record at that point

recipe.description: The recipe the comparison ran with

valid_time.description: Valid time: when the thing happened, a date or a UTC timestamp. Projections fold signals in (time, id) order

transaction_time.description: Transaction time: when the producer recorded it, a UTC timestamp
